title: P1 Architect: make specification and plant measurements monorepo-aware
body: Partial cells F1:T4/T6/T7/T8, F2:T2/T3, F3:T3, F4:T4. Native plant scan counts 108 conventional source files; test coherence counts only four packages. Workspace inventory identifies 63 child packages, six frontend apps, and 750 test files including tool fixtures. Map domain-first roots, existing contracts and canonical specifications; classify generated clients before changing exclusions. Acceptance: explicitly documented complete denominators and no threshold relaxation. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.
